Bacterial_Leaf_Spot.quote: water-soaked lesions on leaves that can quickly change from green to dark brown and enlarge into spots that are up to 1/4 inch in diameter with slightly raised margins.
raised, scab-like spots on fruit render the fruit unmarketable.

Yellow_Mottle_Virus.quote: Chlorotic, mottled, vein-cleared, and distorted leaves characterize the infection.
The virus causes stunted growth and reduction in the intermodal length of infected pepper plants.
